from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

from construct import build_adapter, candidate_readers, corpus
from diagnose import mlp_name, read_weight

path = build_adapter()
with np.load(path, allow_pickle=False) as adapter:
    modules = [mlp_name(layer) for layer in (14, 18)]
    assert set(adapter.files) == {name + '::' + factor for name in modules for factor in ('A', 'B')}
    for name in modules:
        down, up = adapter[name + '::A'], adapter[name + '::B']
        original = read_weight(name)
        height, width = original.shape
        rank = down.shape[0]
        assert down.shape == (rank, width) and up.shape == (height, rank) and 1 <= rank <= 8
        assert down.dtype == up.dtype == np.dtype('float32')
        assert np.isfinite(down).all() and np.isfinite(up).all()
        down, up = down.astype('d'), up.astype('d')
        delta_norm = np.sqrt(np.sum((up.T @ up) * (down @ down.T)))
        ratio = delta_norm / np.linalg.norm(original.astype('d'))
        assert 0 < ratio <= 5
        print(f'{name}: A {down.shape}, B {up.shape}, Frobenius ratio {ratio:.6f}')
        direction = candidate_readers(name)
        for index in [33, 41]:
            held = corpus(index)
            projection = held.data[name] @ direction.T
            candidate = held.roles > 0
            counted = held.unique & ~candidate
            print(f'  held-out trace {index}: median suggested-token read {np.median(projection[candidate].sum(-1)):.3f}; '
                  f'background |read| median {np.median(np.abs(projection[counted].sum(-1))):.3f}')
        for index in [37, 43]:
            held = corpus(index)
            samples = (np.arange(len(held.roles)) % 4 == 3)[:, None] & held.unique
            score = (held.data[name] @ direction.T).sum(-1)[samples]
            print(f'  held-out ordinary controls {index}: |read| p95 {np.quantile(np.abs(score), .95):.3f}')
print(f'Validated {path}: {Path(path).stat().st_size} bytes')
PY
